findings.message: Since PHP 7.0, functions inspecting arguments, like func_get_args(), no longer report the original value as passed to a parameter, but will instead provide the current value. The parameter "$string" was changed on line 50. (PHP 7.0 behaviour: func_get_args() and similar report the current value of a changed parameter, and code that runs on PHP 7 or 8 today already gets this, so the upgrade changes nothing)

Declaring an optional parameter before a required parameter is deprecated since PHP 8.0. Parameter $sub_id is optional, while parameter $subscription is required. The $sub_id parameter is implicitly treated as a required parameter.
